title: Owl Jump Rope
description: Adds a jumping owl with a rope that spawns in villages and explodes when killed.
body:
# Owl Jump Rope

A silly Fabric mod that adds an owl with a jump rope to Minecraft.

The owl hops around with its little rope, can be spawned with a spawn egg, appears naturally near villager villages, and has one very important safety issue: when killed, it explodes.

## Features

- Adds a new mob: **Owl on a Jump Rope**
- Custom model and texture
- Animated jumping behavior
- Jump rope visual attached to the owl
- Spawn egg available in Creative mode
- Naturally appears near villages with villager homes and workstations
- Can be bred with wheat seeds
- Explodes when killed
- English and Russian localization

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.2+**
- Fabric API
- Java **21**

## Notes

The owl explosion uses normal mob explosion behavior, so world damage depends on your game rules.
